# Undercut

Geometry hidden behind other features along the pull direction.

<figure markdown="span">
![Undercut: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/no-undercuts-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Undercut: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/no-undercuts-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }

</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [Plastic Injection Molding](../../reference/processes/plastic-injection-molding.md) | Critical |

## Values

This rule has no number to meet: when it finds the problem, it reports it as the error or warning set here.

Criticality in this process: **Critical** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

| Material | If detected | Source |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| **Default** | Error | Not yet sourced |

Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, ABS, Acetal / POM, PMMA, LCP, Long-Fiber Reinforced Plastics, PA, PC, PET / PBT, PE, PSU, PP, PS, PUR, PVC.

## Messages

!!! failure "Error"

    Undercut Detected: The current geometry is physically trapped relative to the mold opening direction. This will require complex side-actions or lifters, significantly increasing mold cost and maintenance. Redesign the part to eliminate this feature or ensure it can be serviced by a sliding core.
